name: Flame Wipe
description: A wall of flames sweeps across the frame, scorching the first clip ahead of it and leaving the second clip under a fading warm glow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the flames sweep (x right, y up)

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the flames, as a part of the frame height

params.name: scorch
params.description: How much the first clip browns and chars ahead of the flames

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the warm glow left on the second clip

params.name: color
params.description: Tint of the body of the flames
